description: Source code implementing NEON-accelerated IQ compression and decompression for BFP format, including functions for shifting, packing, and unpacking IQ data with NEON intrinsics.

classes.name: iq_compression_bfp_neon
classes.description: Class providing NEON-accelerated compression and decompression methods for IQ data in BFP format.

methods.name: shift_right_x3vector_s16
methods.description: Shifts NEON vectors of 16-bit samples right by a specified exponent, with a switch-case for known exponents.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses IQ data into a buffer using NEON intrinsics, handling multiple resource blocks and exponents.

methods.name: decompress
methods.description: Decompresses NEON-packed IQ data from a buffer into complex brain float samples, supporting NEON acceleration.
